body.p: Far away, there were three brothers. The dog of one of them had the name Hiryamon. One of them was dressing himself, he dressed himself well. They killed a bear, they divided its meat. For one of them he took its head. Then he says: "I'll chop with the axe." It became [the clan] Hukochar. The dog [of] one of them is Hiryamon. It became [the clan] Hirogir. The third one, the Evenki say, [if] somebody dresses well: "He/she decorates", one says. It became [the clan] Udigir. Now, though! The whole clan of Udigir uses to dress well (the family name). The Yelogir people were different. There is the river Limti, there Russians caught [them(?)]. The council's name is Limpeyskij, [it is] named [after] the river (?). The [river] Limti's mouth is into the Katonga [river].[DCh]: "Katonga" is the Evenki name for the river Lower Tunguska. This is the Evenki name, Katonga. The Russian name is [Lower] Tunguska. Long ago the Evenki people came apparently to this land. Then the Yakuts came. Then the Russians came all around. Along the [river] Lena the Russians appeared. Along the [river] Yenisei the Russians appeared. At the [river] Vilyuj the Evenki people have a Yakut language.
